answer_1.quote: Headline Generation tasks have achieved great success both in research and application... we propose a novel Contrastive Learning enhanced Historical Headlines based Headline Generation (CLH3G) model ... we build a new dataset named H3G (Historical Headlines Based Headline Generation) ...

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE and BLEU as metrics to automatically evaluate the quality of generated headlines of all baseline models and our CLH3G model.

answer_4.quote: We also apply Human Evaluation to verify the generated headline style. We randomly sampled 50 news from the test set and asked three annotators to rerank the five generated headline and the reference headline, using three criteria namely fluency, relevance and attraction.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rank the generated headlines (and reference) according to fluency, relevance and attraction, assigning higher points to higher-ranked outputs.
